$comment: Reference definition for the transfer tool the prompt calls at N15 and on interrupt GI-4. Vapi's UI is the place this actually gets configured - this file exists so the intended configuration is version-controlled and reviewable instead of living only in a web form. VERIFY field names against current Vapi docs before relying on this; the transfer API has changed shape before. Replace DESTINATION_NUMBER before use.

function.name: transfer_to_licensed_agent
function.description: Hand the live caller to a licensed human agent. Called at the end of a completed intake, or immediately whenever the caller asks to speak to a person.

destinations.$numberNote: Twilio ring group that rolls to voicemail. See docs/decisions.md.

transferPlan.$modeNote: NOT blind transfer. An unanswered blind transfer drops the caller into silence, which directly undercuts the 'you won't have to repeat yourself' promise. Known issue: warm transfer has been reported connecting immediately instead of honoring the mode. Place a real test call and confirm hold-then-connect actually happens.

messages.content: Summarize this intake for the licensed agent picking up the call, in under fifteen seconds of speech. Lead with the caller's name and program status (Medicare only, Medicaid only, dual-eligible, neither, or unsure). Then ZIP, medications, and cost priority. Flag anything the agent needs to know before speaking: whether the caller asked for a human, whether they declined Scope of Appointment consent, whether they are calling on behalf of someone else, and any medication recorded with low confidence. Do not recommend a plan or interpret eligibility.

fallbackPlan.message: It looks like every agent is with someone right now. Everything we went over is saved for them, and someone will reach out to you shortly. Thanks so much for your patience today.
fallbackPlan.$note: This message is the entire failure path. Vapi cannot resume the assistant after a failed transfer, so this one sentence carries the whole explanation. It promises a human follow-up - that promise is only true if someone actually works the voicemail queue.
